title: Signed Log publication
summary: I built revisioned publishing with portable evidence and recoverable local transactions.

revisions.body:
I built revisioned publishing with portable evidence and recoverable local transactions.

## Problem

A page can change after publication. I wanted readers to inspect the exact Markdown, signatures and revision history behind my writing.

## Approach

I keep signed revision bytes immutable, derive the search and preview data, and activate prepared publication stores through a recoverable transaction. [1]

## Decisions

- Portable archives carry the evidence needed for offline inspection.
- A pinned root and signed key transitions keep identity continuity explicit.
- Timestamp digest binding and Bitcoin confirmation are separate claims.

## Checks

I keep the checks alongside the implementation [5], [6], [7].

## Limitations

- A signature identifies signed bytes and a signing key; it does not establish that the writing is true.
- An independently retained checkpoint needs an actual external observer. The site cannot witness itself.

title: Monero contribution ledger
summary: I separated the public contribution flow from a durable payment ledger and a view-only wallet agent.

revisions.body:
I separated the public contribution flow from a durable payment ledger and a view-only wallet agent.

## Problem

A retry or lost response must not give a visitor a different payment address or turn uncertain chain state into a paid claim.

## Approach

I reserve the contribution ID before allocation, persist the canonical amount and unique subaddress, and recover matching orders through authenticated read-only requests. [1]

## Decisions

- Amounts use integer piconero rather than floating-point arithmetic.
- The public site calls a loopback gateway; wallet credentials stay in the agent.
- Uncertain allocation and stale chain health fail closed instead of inventing a replacement address or successful payment.

## Checks

I keep the checks alongside the implementation [5], [6], [7].

## Limitations

- Synthetic checkout and scanner tests do not prove real Monero settlement.
- Live stagenet partial payments, reorgs and operational backup/restart remain deployment gates.
